primarySourceInputs.observedPattern: Dedicated VS Code extension manifest with engines.vscode, extensionKind, activationEvents, main entry point, commands, configuration, and view contributions.
AI coding assistant is distributed through a VS Code extension manifest with activation events, extension entry point, and contributed workbench surfaces.
VS Code treats package.json extension manifest fields such as engines.vscode, main, contributes, and activationEvents as the authoritative extension surface.
Contribution points are JSON declarations in package.json contributes, covering commands, configuration, views, menus, keybindings, languages, and related workbench integration.

validationRequiredBeforeAvailabilityClai: Create the proposed manifest and extension entry point under packages/openclaude-vscode.
Run a local manifest schema check for engines.vscode, activationEvents, contributes.commands, contributes.views, contributes.configuration, and extensionKind.
Run a local extension package dry-run without publishing or marketplace upload.
Run a no-phone-home check over the extension bundle and generated package.
Run local command-contribution smoke tests for open chat, run selection, explain selection, and runtime doctor commands.
Record provider/live/external call boundaries before any demo, marketplace, or public availability claim.
